university.name: University of Sussex
university.summary: UK university with its campus at Falmer, Brighton, offering undergraduate, Masters and PhD study across business, law, engineering, computing, psychology and the social sciences. An on-campus International Study Centre, maintained by Study Group, runs foundation routes for international students progressing to Sussex degrees.
university.eligibility_note: Licensed student sponsor, Student route, status 'Student Sponsor - Track Record' (gov.uk register file dated 2026-10-07)

courses.title: Computer Science BSc (Hons)
courses.overview: Three year degree covering programming, data structures, databases and machine learning, with routes that add an industrial placement year or an integrated MComp. UCAS code G400.
courses.academic_requirements: A-levels: typical offer ABB-BBB. GCSE (or equivalent) Mathematics at grade 6 (or grade B).
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall, including at least 5.5 in each component.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan (as published): You can apply for direct entry to Year 1 if you are completing at least two years of Bachelor degree studies. Applicants with the Intermediate Certificate or HSC normally need a Foundation year first, for example the International Foundation Year at the International Study Centre. Additional requirement: a good level of Mathematics.
courses.notes: Fee shown on the September 2027 entry course page; the page does not label the fee year explicitly and states fees may be subject to an annual increase. pk_route left null: the published route (two years of Bachelor study) does not map exactly to the enum.

courses.title: Law LLB (Hons)
courses.overview: Three year qualifying law degree covering the core areas of English law, including contract, tort and public law, with optional modules in later years. UCAS code M100.
courses.academic_requirements: A-levels: typical offer AAB-ABB. A broad range of GCSEs 9-4 (A*-C), including good grades in relevant subjects.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall, including at least 5.5 in each component.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan (as published): You can apply for direct entry to Year 1 if you are completing at least two years of Bachelor degree studies. Entry requirements are guidelines and applications are assessed case by case.
courses.notes: Fee shown on the September 2027 entry course page; the page does not label the fee year explicitly and states fees may be subject to an annual increase. Home fee on the same page is GBP 10,050.

courses.title: Mechanical Engineering BEng (Hons)
courses.overview: Three year engineering degree combining mathematics, design, programming and electrical fundamentals, with variants that add an industrial placement year or lead to an integrated MEng. UCAS code H300.
courses.academic_requirements: A-levels: typical offer ABB-BBB. A-levels must include Mathematics, with at least grade B.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall, including at least 5.5 in each component.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan (as published): You can apply for direct entry to Year 1 if you are completing at least two years of Bachelor degree studies. Evidence of existing academic ability at a high level in Mathematics is essential.
courses.notes: Fee shown on the September 2027 entry course page; the page does not label the fee year explicitly and states fees may be subject to an annual increase.

courses.title: Psychology BSc (Hons)
courses.overview: Three year degree treating psychology as a science, covering cognition, social psychology and data analysis, with an option to add a professional placement year. UCAS code C800.
courses.academic_requirements: A-levels: typical offer AAB. GCSE Mathematics at grade 4 (or grade C) and a broad range of GCSEs grade 9-4 (A*-C).
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall, including at least 5.5 in each component.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan (as published): You can apply for direct entry to Year 1 if you are completing at least two years of Bachelor degree studies. You must have a good level of Mathematics. Applications are assessed case by case.
courses.notes: Fee shown on the September 2027 entry course page; the page does not label the fee year explicitly and states fees may be subject to an annual increase.

courses.title: International Foundation Year
courses.award: International Foundation Year (pathway to University of Sussex degrees)
courses.overview: Two semester preparation programme at the University of Sussex International Study Centre on the Falmer campus, with subject pathways leading to Sussex undergraduate degrees for students who complete it at the required level.
courses.academic_requirements: Good high school graduation grades or equivalent. Applicants must turn 18 by 1 September of the year they complete the ISC course and progress.
courses.english_requirements: Academic IELTS for UKVI 5.0 overall (min 5.0 in writing); Medicine route 6.0 overall (min 6 in writing and 5.5 in all other components). PTE Academic UKVI, LanguageCert Academic SELT and other listed tests also accepted.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan (as published): Year 12 (HSC / Intermediate Certificate Part I and II) or Polytechnic Diploma: 50% overall with passes in min 4 subjects; or Year 11 (Intermediate Part I): 60% overall with passes in min 4 subjects. 50% in relevant subjects required.
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published: GBP 21,500 is the 2026/27 fee (Business, Humanities, Science and Engineering) for programmes starting on or after 26 August 2026. Confirmation payment GBP 1,000 deposit plus GBP 260 non-refundable admin fee, then GBP 6,000 advance payment before CAS. Medicine pathway requires a higher confirmation payment. The ISC is maintained by Study Group (not INTO). The page lists September, November and January entry points without 2027 dates. field_slug set to business-management for the multi-pathway programme; duration_months left null as only 'two semesters' is published.

courses.title: Management MSc
courses.overview: One year taught Masters in management open to graduates from any subject, covering organisational behaviour, the global business environment and business analysis, with an optional consultancy project.
courses.academic_requirements: Lower second-class (2.2) undergraduate honours degree or above, in any subject. Other professional qualifications or equivalent experience may be considered.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with at least 5.5 in each component; PTE Academic 59 overall with 59 in all four skills; TOEFL iBT (tests from 21 January 2026) 4 overall with 4 in each skill, or (tests before 21 January 2026) 80 overall with 17 Listening, 18 Reading, 20 Speaking, 17 Writing; Duolingo 110 overall with no component below 105.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan (as published): Four-year Bachelors degree with an overall mark of at least 60%-65% or CGPA 2.4 - 2.6 depending on your university; or Masters degree following a 3-year Bachelors degree with the same mark range. CGPA scale not stated, so not converted.
courses.application_deadline_note: 1 August 2027 (international); some courses may close earlier.
courses.notes: Fee shown on the September 2027 entry course page; the page does not label the fee year explicitly and states fees may be subject to an annual increase. A January 2027 start is also listed. Self-funded international students pay a tuition fee deposit. min_toefl left null because Sussex now publishes TOEFL on the new 1 to 6 scale (4 overall) alongside the old 0 to 120 scale (80 overall).

courses.title: Artificial Intelligence and Adaptive Systems MSc
courses.overview: One year taught Masters on artificial intelligence, machine learning and adaptive systems, with mathematical foundations and an individual project, for graduates from scientific, technical or related disciplines.
courses.academic_requirements: Upper second-class (2.1) undergraduate honours degree or above in a scientific or technical subject or other discipline (including computing and cognitive subjects).
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with at least 5.5 in each component; PTE Academic 59 overall with 59 in all four skills; TOEFL iBT (tests from 21 January 2026) 4 overall with 4 in each skill, or (tests before 21 January 2026) 80 overall with 17 Listening, 18 Reading, 20 Speaking, 17 Writing; Duolingo 110 overall with no component below 105.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan (as published): Four-year Bachelors degree with an overall mark of at least 60%-65% or CGPA 2.4 - 2.6 depending on your university; or Masters degree following a 3-year Bachelors degree with the same mark range. CGPA scale not stated, so not converted.
courses.notes: Fee shown on the September 2027 entry course page; the page does not label the fee year explicitly and states fees may be subject to an annual increase. min_toefl left null because Sussex now publishes TOEFL on the new 1 to 6 scale (4 overall) alongside the old 0 to 120 scale (80 overall).

courses.title: Accounting and Finance MSc
courses.overview: One year taught Masters covering financial reporting, corporate finance with AI applications and global financial institutions, finishing with a research dissertation. Applicants need prior study with basic coverage of accounting and finance.
highlights: Institutions in the Global Financial Market
courses.academic_requirements: Lower second-class (2.2) undergraduate honours degree or above, in a subject with basic coverage of accounting and finance.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with at least 5.5 in each component; PTE Academic 59 overall with 59 in all four skills; TOEFL iBT (tests from 21 January 2026) 4 overall with 4 in each skill, or (tests before 21 January 2026) 80 overall with 17 Listening, 18 Reading, 20 Speaking, 17 Writing; Duolingo 110 overall with no component below 105.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan (as published): Four-year Bachelors degree with an overall mark of at least 60%-65% or CGPA 2.4 - 2.6 depending on your university; or Masters degree following a 3-year Bachelors degree with the same mark range. CGPA scale not stated, so not converted. Subject must have basic coverage of accounting and finance; applications assessed case by case.
courses.notes: Fee shown on the September 2027 entry course page; the page does not label the fee year explicitly and states fees may be subject to an annual increase. min_toefl left null because Sussex now publishes TOEFL on the new 1 to 6 scale (4 overall) alongside the old 0 to 120 scale (80 overall).

courses.title: International Relations MA
courses.overview: One year taught Masters covering world politics and international relations theory, with research methods training and a dissertation. Applicants preferably hold a social sciences or humanities degree.
courses.academic_requirements: Upper second-class (2.1) undergraduate honours degree or above, preferably in a social sciences or humanities subject.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with at least 5.5 in each component; PTE Academic 59 overall with 59 in all four skills; TOEFL iBT (tests from 21 January 2026) 4 overall with 4 in each skill, or (tests before 21 January 2026) 80 overall with 17 Listening, 18 Reading, 20 Speaking, 17 Writing; Duolingo 110 overall with no component below 105.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan (as published): Four-year Bachelors degree with an overall mark of at least 60%-65% or CGPA 2.4 - 2.6 depending on your university; or Masters degree following a 3-year Bachelors degree with the same mark range. CGPA scale not stated, so not converted.
courses.notes: Fee shown on the September 2027 entry course page; the page does not label the fee year explicitly and states fees may be subject to an annual increase. min_toefl left null because Sussex now publishes TOEFL on the new 1 to 6 scale (4 overall) alongside the old 0 to 120 scale (80 overall).

scholarships.name: MBA Impact Scholarship (2026)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 2,500 to GBP 5,000 tuition fee reduction
scholarships.summary: Tuition fee reduction for Sussex MBA entrants, assessed on management experience and evidence of positive impact. Applicants apply after accepting an MBA offer.
scholarships.criteria_text: Hold an offer of a place on the Sussex MBA starting September 2026 or January 2027; have management experience. Eligible country list includes Pakistan and the United Kingdom.
scholarships.notes: 2026 award cycle; only the January 2027 MBA intake falls in 2027. Number of awards, value basis and fee status rules not stated. The MBA is not among the researched courses. Application link: https://www.sussex.ac.uk/study/fees-funding/masters-scholarships/apply-for-mba-impact-scholarship

scholarships.name: Sussex Pakistan Scholarship (Masters) (2026)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 4,000 reduction on first year tuition fees
scholarships.summary: Automatic tuition fee reduction for self-financing Pakistani nationals with overseas fee status starting a full-time Sussex Masters, shown on the CAS once confirmed.
scholarships.criteria_text: National of Pakistan; overseas fee status; self-financing; full-time Masters starting September 2026 or January 2027. Certificates, diplomas, online, BSMS and some MA development courses excluded.
scholarships.deadline_note: 1 September 2026, 23:59 (GMT); page states the deadline has expired
scholarships.notes: Page covers January 2027 starts but marks the 1 September 2026 deadline as expired, so new January 2027 applicants may not qualify. No 2027/28 version published yet; course pages state scholarship details for 2027/28 are not yet set. Do not publish as open for September 2027 until Sussex releases the 2027 terms.
